theorems.name: Submission.variation_matrix_det_leibniz_second_order_at_one
theorems.statement: ∀ (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (B : Matrix ι ι ℝ), ∑ σ : Equiv.Perm ι, ((Equiv.Perm.sign σ : ℤ) : ℝ) * ∑ m : ι, (∑ l ∈ Finset.univ.erase m, (∏ j ∈ (Finset.univ.erase m).erase l, (1 : Matrix ι ι ℝ) (σ j) j) * B (σ l) l) * B (σ m) m = B.trace ^ 2 - (B * B).trace
